meta.title: January Fun at the Town Library

paragraphs: On Saturday morning, Tom and Ben stood at the door of the town library. It was a cool morning, and the library had just opened. A big leaflet stood in a box next to the door. Tom took two copies and gave one to Ben. "January Fun at the Town Library," read Ben. "It is an event for the whole town."

The first part of the leaflet gave the date and the time. "Date: Saturday, January sixteenth." Ben read the date twice to be sure. "Time: from nine o'clock to four o'clock." "Price: free." "Free?" said Tom. "That is great, because I have only a little money." "The event is not today," said Ben. "It is in two weeks, so we have time."

The second part told about the activities. "Chess for beginners: ten o'clock, in the big hall." "Story hour for children: eleven o'clock." "Book sale: all day." "The library lends chess boards, and it is free." "I love chess!" said Ben. Ben knew the names of all the pieces, but Tom did not. "I am a beginner, but I learn fast," said Tom. "Then we will go to the chess activity," he added.

The third part showed a map of the library. Tom put his finger on the map. "The library has two departments," said Tom. "The children's department is on the first floor." "The lending department is across the hall." "What is the lending department?" asked Ben. "It is the desk where you borrow books," said Tom. "You may borrow five books for two weeks." They looked across the hall and saw the lending desk.

The last part gave the rules. "Please talk softly in the library." "Please turn the sound off on your phone." "No food or drink near the books." "Those rules are easy," said Tom. "I want more information about the chess activity," said Ben. The two boys walked to the desk and asked a woman for a chess board. She lent them a small board with a book of rules. They played their first game at a quiet table. Ben whispered the names of the pieces, because the room was so quiet. Tom learned three of them before lunch.
text.summary: Tom and Ben read a leaflet for an event at the town library. They find the times, the activities, the departments, and the rules, and they plan a chess afternoon.
